preFreshmanVerified.note: Ashton Johnson, Boyd Buchanan, class of 2029. Placed at the 2025 TSSAA championship before his freshman year, which Tennessee allows: TSSAA Handbook Art. II §8 admits eighth graders, and the brackets print '8th' as the grade, which is how the class year was derived in the first place. All fourteen of these are Division II independents. Different from Maryland (COMAR 13A.06.03.02, grades 9-12 only) and Virginia (VHSL 28-2-1, eighth graders on junior varsity only), where the same shape proved a class year wrong (25 Oct 2026).
